title: Starter Kit: Annotated screenshots and README infographics for onboarding
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a compact set of annotated reference screenshots, step-by-step README infographics, and export-ready assets for the Template Starter Kit used in the quickstart docs. Deliverables will support two onboarding flows: Hosted API quickstart and Dedicated capacity quickstart. Assets should be exportable for mobile/desktop docs and the Console hero image.
screenshots_needed: Console: create-api-key modal (annotated arrows to fields)
Console: model selection dropdown with recommended models highlighted
Starter app: local run CLI output with highlighted success line
Starter app: sample chat UI with placeholder prompt + system message annotation
Network diagram: hosted vs dedicated flow (3 nodes annotated)
designer_notes: Aim for 2 visual densities: full-annotated (for internal docs & Confluence) and condensed single-image variants (for README and landing). Use existing Redwood UI tokens; avoid introducing brand-new components. Prefer SVG exports for diagrams and 2x PNGs for screenshots. Coordinate with Eng on sample data redaction (ENG-3471).
acceptance_criteria: Five final annotated screenshots exported in PNG@2x and SVG where applicable
README infographic (single-page) in SVG and PDF with clear callouts for 3 onboarding steps
Figma file with named layers and a 'release-ready' page containing final frames
README in docs repo updated with new images and a short copy refresh (PR linked)
Assets uploaded to s3://redwood-assets/onboarding/starter-kit/screenshots/ with versioned folder
